Hey Juri,

The only thing I can say about EUR-USD is the zone that price ignored was a RBD reaction to to original supply to the left. The only time you can trade a reactive level safely is if you know its already consumed the MPL of the zone its a reaction to. In this case, it hadn't, and the nasty FO occurs.

It is hard to wait for price to FO to these extreme levels, mainly because it doesn't always happen, and psychologically it's hard to see an engulf and wait for the deepest RT - especially when it only happens sometimes. I guess that is why trading is also a test of emotions.

author: Jurij
text:
Nearing the period of the year where the markets dry up.

It's a good opportunity to do some reviewing and further studying over the holidays.

I found you, the RTM community, exactly 1 year and 3 days ago.

Amazing what I learned from you all in this time.

I want to thank Kovalenko for introducing me to RTM on FF while he was posting his awesome trades.

Many thanks to Salivan, Omid, hoeschec, Michal238, Smimon, shadowpit and all other community members, I learned a lot from you.

A big thank you to all master traders for your great journals and guidance.

Huge thank you to IF, who made this all possible and for being so kind to enlighten us on the path out of the retail trading mess.

1 year full time study on RTM was absolutely worth.

Everyone can do this with enough dedication and hard work.

Of course you can speed this up by taking an RTMA course but it is, without a doubt, not required to succeed.

This site is full of free content, sadly it has become a habit to consider only paid content as valuable.

I mean, nothing against RTMA, but it's incredible how trolls ask for proof from IF when everything here is free.

This site and the journals are the proof.

Just check it out for yourself, it costs nothing.

If you don't see any value then trading or this approach is just not for you.

Anyway, 2017 will be great.

I wish everyone the best for next year and don't forget to enjoy also some time off from the market with your family, loved ones or just with what you love to do (other than trading )

author: Jurij
text:
Each time I listen again (4th time now) to this webinar something new comes to my attention.

It really is one of the best and most important videos, in my opinion.

Surprising how easily our brain overhears little details and the extend of lack of focus.

So, the new detail I noticed this time was the clue IF gave about the change ITs made.

I'm not going to spoil it, as I respect IF's work.

Really he actually says it in the webinar and then once someone ask about it specifically he gives a hint.

Basically, if I'm not mistaken (always possible), the change affects greatly S/R traders by letting them miss their targets and hit their stops. Before the change, S/R trading was easier, but as soon as everyone started to trade this way more and more, the market had to change, as only a few can win and the masses must be always on the other losing side.

There's good news though, if you follow IF's teachings you are already aware of it and should not fall for this trick.

I'm pretty sure that those who have put in many charting hours probably already noticed this kind of trick, so nothing really special.

Other key questions answered in the webinar above:

1. What is an MPL?

2. What is a scale and how to trade the PA in the right scale?

3. What is the origin of the move?

5. What is PA and when do we have PA?

6. And more....

Just a reminder to watch these videos over and over (while our general understanding progresses) as each time there's a possibility of noticing something new.

author: althoufx
text:
Hi Jurij

about your old USDCAD i think this is a typical esample of reading that can be done in 2 opposite ways (one right, the other wrong) depending on the training level.

In hindsight that setup must be readed for sure as ignored supply (or trick), so i think it's clear what happened at that level, but at the moment many would have readed as you did.

it was a kind of trap or fake like many many others we see anytime on any chart. The market is totally full of these stuffs.

As more time i'm spending at the screen as more i can see the price mostly makes fakes and traps, being the true setups well hidden in the noise.

It means these fakes/traps could be traded as well. It would be enough the trader kept thinking as a trap-maker. (Salivan gave some examples of this)

There are some sentences by IF that could be viewed as general, so that most of us don't focuse enough on their deep and practical importance:

about HW (most uf them) ....until you'll be able to see these stuffs as you walk... (or very similar words..)

"....reading the market as a second nature..."

specially the last one gives a good idea of the mental approach necessary to trade in RTM profitably.

So the charts have to be readed as a book, a journal. We could even "feel" the price in that mental condition.

It's an approach totally involving and professional, with a huge dedication. It needs time and strength....

Sorry for this post not technical, but it was a think i wanted to share from a while

many thanks, all the best
